narr: Widespread showers and thunderstorms produced locally heavy rain in eastern Pennsylvania on July 16. Rainfall totals were as high as 3 to 5 inches.
ev: A vehicle became trapped in flood waters at the intersection of Mine Lane Road and Division Street in Palmer Township, necessitating a water rescue.

Flood waters reached the first floor of a house in Washington Township, causing a basement wall to collapse. A bridge on Lower South Main Street in the township was severely damaged due to rushing flood waters.
Multiple vehicles became trapped in flood waters at the intersection of Sullivan Trail and Newlins Road West in Forks Township.

There were multiple vehicles trapped in flood waters in Lower Mount Bethel Township, necessitating several water rescues. Several vehicles were swept off the roadway by flood waters near Martins Creek.
Bushkill Creek overflowed its banks along the border of Palmer Township and Forks Township. Much of Bushkill Park in Forks Township was under water.
Bushkill Creek overflowed its banks and flooded apartment buildings along the border of Palmer Township and the borough of Wilson. Residents were evacuated from the complex.
PA Route 33 northbound was closed between the Stockertown and Belfast interchanges due to flooding. At least one vehicle became trapped in the flood waters, necessitating a water rescue.
